articles.title: La combinada de LaLiga - 19/09
articles.standfirst: 1XBET te ofrece la apuesta combinada de la jornada 7 de LaLiga 26-27, correspondiente a los encuentros del 19 de septiembre
articles.summary: 1XBET te ofrece la apuesta combinada de la jornada 7 de LaLiga 26-27, correspondiente a los encuentros del 19 de septiembre
articles.body: LaLiga afronta su última jornada de este inicio liguero antes de sumergirse en el primer parón de selecciones de la temporada, que mantendrá la competición en 'stand by' durante tres semanas. El duelo estrella de este sábado será el que acoja el Sánchez Pizjuán entre Sevilla y Barcelona... aunque también habrá otros tres encuentros con protagonismo: Osasuna recibe al Rayo Vallecano, el Alavés visita San Mamés y Balaídos disfrutará con un Celta-Racing. Cuatro partidos que ofrecen diferentes alternativas para las apuestas online de la mano de 1XBET. Pronóstico 1: Osasuna no marca El Rayo Vallecano no ha conseguido dejar su portería a cero en ninguno de los partidos disputados esta temporada, una dinámica que también se ha repetido en sus cinco últimos enfrentamientos directos frente a Osasuna. Sin embargo, los de Ramis parecen tener la pólvora mojada en este inicio de temporada, ya que no han conseguido marcar en tres de las seis jornadas disputadas y se han quedado sin ver portería en las dos últimas de manera consecutiva. Que Osasuna no marque contra el Rayo presenta una cuota de 3.50 en 1XBET. Pronóstico 2: Menos de 2.5 goles totales El precedente más claro para este duelo aparece en los enfrentamientos directos, ya que en nueve de los diez últimos partidos entre Athletic y Alavés se registraron menos de 2.5 goles. Además, sólo en dos de los cinco encuentros disputados por el Athletic esta temporada se ha superado esta línea, mientras que en el caso del Alavés ha sucedido en la mitad de sus compromisos. Con estos datos, la opción de que haya menos de 2.5 goles totales alcanza una cuota de 1.88 en 1XBET. Una alternativa interesante para las casas de apuestas online. Pronóstico 3: Portería a cero del Racing El Racing ha encajado gol en las seis primeras jornadas de LaLiga, aunque este encuentro ante el Celta puede representar una oportunidad para romper esa dinámica. El conjunto gallego tan sólo ha marcado tres goles en este inicio de temporada y se ha quedado sin ver portería en la mitad de sus partidos. Unos registros que abren la puerta a que el Racing consiga mantener su portería a cero por primera vez en el campeonato. La opción de que el conjunto cántabro no encaje ningún gol presenta una cuota de 5.00 en 1XBET. Pronóstico 4: Gol antes del 15' Los primeros minutos también pueden tener protagonismo en el duelo del Sánchez Pizjuán. En cinco de los seis partidos disputados por el Barcelona esta temporada se ha marcado al menos un gol antes del primer cuarto de hora. Una circunstancia que también se ha dado en tres de los seis encuentros del Sevilla. Además, los dos enfrentamientos entre ambos equipos de la pasada temporada tuvieron un gol antes del minuto 15. Que haya un tanto antes del primer cuarto de hora alcanza una cuota de 2.50 en 1XBET. La combinada propuesta para este sábado reúne que Osasuna no marque contra el Rayo (3.50), el menos de 2.5 goles totales en el Athletic-Alavés (1.88), la portería a cero del Racing ante el Celta (5.00) y que haya un gol antes del 15' en el Sevilla-Barcelona (2.50). La cuota combinada asciende hasta 82.25, fruto de la multiplicación de las cuatro cuotas. Una propuesta de 1XBET para la séptima jornada de LaLiga 26-27: la última antes del primer parón de selecciones de la temporada.

articles.summary: Celta y Racing se enfrentan en Balaídos con el objetivo de sumar tres puntos que les permitan escalar posiciones en la clasificación
articles.body: Celta y Racing se enfrentan el sábado 19 de septiembre a las 18:30 horas en el estadio Abanca-Balaídos en el partido correspondiente a la jornada 7 de LaLiga EA Sports. El Celta llega tras empatar contra la Real Sociedad. El equipo gallego necesita sumar puntos para alejarse de los puestos bajos de la clasificación. Actualmente, el equipo dirigido por Claudio Giráldez se encuentra en decimosexta posición con cuatro puntos. Por su parte, el Racing llega tras perder contra el Barcelona. El equipo cántabro quiere sumar tres puntos para escalar posiciones en la clasificación. Actualmente, el equipo dirigido por José Alberto López Menéndez se encuentra en décima posición con siete puntos. El partido entre Celta y Racing se juega hoy sábado 19 de septiembre a las 18:30 horas en el estadio Abanca Balaídos. El partido entre Celta y Racing se podrá ver por televisión en directo a través del canal Movistar LaLiga. También se podrá seguir el partido a través de la narración de Radio MARCA y con los comentarios en directo de MARCA.com. Desde dos horas antes, sigue la previa y los onces. Tras el encuentro, podrás leer la crónica, las declaraciones de los protagonistas y ver el resumen con las mejores jugadas y los goles. articles.title: Los derbis más polémicos: expulsiones, penaltis y decisiones arbitrales que aún se recuerdan
articles.standfirst: Desde la patada de Buyo hasta los líos con los ultras en el Metropolitano
articles.summary: Desde la patada de Buyo hasta los líos con los ultras en el Metropolitano
articles.body: Los derbis entre Atlético y Real Madrid siempre han sido mucho más que un partido de fútbol. En ellos se mezclan historia, estilos de juego opuestos y una rivalidad que se respira en cada grada de la ciudad. A lo largo de las décadas, estos duelos han dejado capítulos tan vibrantes como controvertidos, con jugadas discutidas, decisiones arbitrales que marcaron época, expulsiones, incidentes en la grada y escenas que todavía alimentan la memoria colectiva de ambas aficiones. El 29 de septiembre de 2024, el derbi en el Metropolitano se vio interrumpido cuando desde la grada baja del fondo sur, donde se ubican los ultras del Frente Atlético, se lanzaron mecheros, botellas y otros objetos contra Thibaut Courtois. La situación obligó al árbitro a detener el partido durante más de un cuarto de hora hasta que se restablecieron las condiciones mínimas de seguridad. El encuentro, muy tenso desde el inicio, terminó 1-1 y además se cerró con la expulsión de Marcos Llorente en el descuento tras una dura entrada sobre Fran García revisada en el VAR. En la temporada 1988-89 se disputó un derbi que pasó a la historia por su dureza. El Real Madrid acabó imponiéndose por 2-1 gracias a un tanto agónico de Martín Vázquez en el minuto 91, pero el recuerdo principal fue la bronca desatada sobre el césped. Paco Buyo protagonizó una acción muy comentada al salir con todo contra Futre, lo que generó un tumulto entre jugadores de ambos equipos. También hubo expulsiones que encendieron más los ánimos y escenas de auténtica batalla campal, con empujones y protestas continuas. La imagen de un Calderón en llamas, consolidó ese encuentro como uno de los derbis más calientes de la historia. El 18 de noviembre de 2017, en el Metropolitano, Sergio Ramos sufrió una fractura de tabique nasal tras una acción de Lucas Hernández. El defensa del Atlético golpeó con la pierna a Ramos cuando éste trataba de rematar de cabeza en el área. El capitán del Madrid jugó algunos minutos más con la nariz ensangrentada, pero no pudo salir en la segunda parte y quedó varios encuentros de baja. El partido, trabado y sin grandes ocasiones claras, terminó en empate sin goles. La jugada marcó la tensión de un derbi que en lo futbolístico no dejó demasiado, pero sí la imagen de Ramos lesionado en un duelo donde el contacto físico superó al fútbol. El 25 de febrero de 2007, en el Vicente Calderón, se vivió otro de los episodios polémicos más recordados. Con el Atlético por delante en el marcador tras un tanto de Fernando Torres, Luis Amaranto Perea anotó lo que parecía el 2-0. El árbitro y su asistente anularon el tanto por un supuesto fuera de juego que no existía. La indignación en la grada fue inmediata y el Calderón estalló contra el colegiado. Aquel gol podría haber cambiado el rumbo del partido, que finalmente terminó 1-1. Para los rojiblancos, aquella decisión arbitral se convirtió en un ejemplo más de la “maldición” que sufrían frente a su eterno rival. El 8 de febrero de 2025, en el Santiago Bernabéu, el derbi volvió a estar marcado por la polémica arbitral. El Atlético se adelantó desde el punto de penalti tras una revisión del VAR que sancionó un pisotón de Aurélien Tchouaméni sobre Samu Lino. La decisión encendió las protestas del madridismo, que entendía la acción como leve e involuntaria. El ambiente ya estaba cargado tras el cruce de comunicados relacionados con el CTA y las posteriores réplicas del Atlético en sus redes sociales. El empate 1-1 dejó la sensación de que, una vez más, el protagonismo se repartió entre el fútbol y la polémica arbitral.

articles.title: Why Florida is at the center of a fight that's holding up the Protect College Sports Act
articles.summary: A small number of schools, including Florida State and Miami, are objecting to the bill's language against conference expansion. Translation: they want the a...
articles.body:
Conference realignment has found its way to Capitol Hill — and the White House too.

A provision in the Protect College Sports Act making it more difficult for programs to move leagues is rankling members and their respective universities, especially in the state of Florida.

What is: The issue has now caught the attention of the most prominent political figures at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue, according to New York Yankees president Randy Levine, one of the influential developers of the legislation and who President Donald Trump has appointed to lead the executive branch's congressional efforts.

Levine, who has direct communication with commissioners, university presidents and board chairs in the SEC and Big Ten, is strongly encouraging the two Florida senators, Ashley Moody and Rick Scott, to support the legislation as their schools "have nowhere else to go," he said. On Thursday, the senators voted against the second of three procedural motions as two of their most prominent state universities (Florida State and Miami) have raised issues with the legislation. They were two of only three Republicans to vote 'no' in a vote that reached a whopping 77 supporters .

"I understand the Florida State and Miami concerns," Levine told Yahoo Sports on Friday. "I've tried hard to resolve them, but the fact is clear: The Big Ten and SEC have told me they have no plans to expand in the near future. In the foreseeable future, they do not see any addition of Florida State or Miami."

Commissioners Greg Sankey (SEC) and Tony Petitti (Big Ten) have publicly said that they are satisfied with their current membership. However, as conference television contracts come to an end — or, in the SEC's case, as a contractual look-in arrives — realignment is expected to re-emerge over the next four years.

The Big Ten's current television contract ends in 2030. The SEC has a 2030 look-in within its contract. On the heels of lawsuits from Florida State and Miami, the ACC established exit fees that drop below $100 million within the next two years, setting up a potential jockeying of programs lobbying for membership in the SEC and Big Ten — the two richest college conferences in America.

The bill's expansion provision makes it more difficult.

It caps the number of schools in a power conference at 19 and requires power league schools wanting to move to another power conference to operate as an independent for three years. Bill authors reduced the previous five-year probationary period to three ahead of Thursday's vote and added a termination clause (called a "sunset" concept) to the probationary period — it ends within six years of the bill's enactment.

The change did not satisfy many programs in the state of Florida that want to have the flexibility to move to the SEC or Big Ten, or even the ACC. South Florida officials have also expressed concerns with their lawmakers over the membership cap, which could impact their path to a power league. The Bulls, one of the more well-resourced Group of Six programs, are working to elevate themselves.

The conference cap significantly limits any movement from schools in the ACC and Big 12 to the SEC (currently 16 schools) and Big Ten (currently 18). The 19 figure is an odd number for conferences that usually have an even number of members for scheduling purposes. It provides the Big Ten with a single spot for the potential addition of the most valuable school outside of the Big Ten and SEC: Notre Dame. The Irish remain committed, for now, to continue as a football independent.

The membership cap is not affected by the newest revision. The sunset clause only applies to the concept's three-year probationary period.

Also, says one school administrator, the six-year sunset concept ending in 2032 (if the bill is enacted now) extends too long. Many school executives have identified 2029-2031 for movement.

Officials from at least five ACC schools — Clemson, North Carolina and Stanford, too — have expressed concerns to lawmakers over the provision. In fact, last week, university officials proposed a variety of revisions to the clause: eliminate it completely; terminate the probationary period after two or three years; or increase the power league membership cap to 20-24 teams.

The expansion provision could pose a problem in the House of Representatives, where states like Florida, California and North and South Carolina hold more than 100 delegates.

"The schools are already working their House members against it," said one congressional official.

The legislation, intended to regulate the college athletics industry by establishing guardrails, is on the brink of passage in the Senate: a final vote is expected likely mid to late next week. The bill limits player transfer movement, grants the NCAA enforcement powers to regulate athlete compensation and establishes a five-year eligibility standard, among over provisions.

Leaders from all three schools — FSU, Miami and USF — posted social media messages Friday in support of the bill while also lauding their senators over their decision to, for now, vote 'no.'

"If the few provisions in the bill regarding conference membership are adjusted to become satisfactory, universities in our state will continue to thrive in the future," USF athletic director Rob Higgins posted .

"[The senators] have stood up to heavy political pressure to do right by Florida universities," tweeted Rudy Fernandez , Miami's executive vice president for operations and senior advisor to the school's president.

"We are grateful to [the senators] for working to address the bill's provisions related to conference realignment," a statement from Florida State said .

In an interview Thursday after the vote, Sen. Eric Schmitt, one of the authors of the legislation, said he believes the provision provides more stability within a college sports landscape rocked by conference movement over the last several decades.

"All this stuff will settle down and that's kind of the point," he said.

Without the provision, lawmakers fear that the SEC and Big Ten might eventually "join forces to create a super league," Sen. Ted Cruz said.

In an interview with Yahoo Sports on Tuesday, another co-author, Sen. Maria Cantwell, expressed openness about relaxing the provision — to a point.

"People want to know that conferences are going to be strong and not undermined and that you're not going to have a ton of ways in which people are going to run off and create a super league or move around too much," she said. "But you do want to honor some flexibility."

Levine's comments signal frustration from the president, who in a social media post on Thursday celebrated the latest bill vote while critical of the nay votes from Scott and Moody. Trump has said that Levine speaks for him on this matter.

"I talk directly to the commissioners and the school presidents," Levine said. "There is nowhere for Florida State and Miami to go right now."

For a couple of years now, expansion conversations among executives in the SEC — off line and not at all formal — have centered around other schools than those in Florida, sources with knowledge tell Yahoo Sports. North Carolina and Virginia provide the league with a presence in two new states, high achieving academic brands and strong basketball programs.

Within the league, Florida and South Carolina stand as threats to any addition of other in-state programs such as FSU, Miami and Clemson. A similar situation unfolded years ago with Texas A&M. The Aggies privately objected to the SEC's pursuit of Texas.

articles.title: El Córdoba renace a costa de un Alba hundido
articles.standfirst: En el Belmonte se marcó el gol más rápido en lo que va de Liga: Álex Rubio, a los ¡30 segundos!
articles.summary: En el Belmonte se marcó el gol más rápido en lo que va de Liga: Álex Rubio, a los ¡30 segundos!
articles.body: El Albacete desperdició una ventaja temprana y acabó perdiendo ante un Córdoba que reaccionó tras el descanso y castigó los errores defensivos de los manchegos. Álex Rubio adelantó al Alba antes del primer minuto, pero los visitantes empataron en la segunda parte por mediación de Isma Ruiz y culminaron la remontada con un gol de Percan. El conjunto de Alberto González volvió a sufrir con las lesiones y terminó completamente desdibujado y pitado por su público. Eso sí, en el Carlos Belmonte se marcó el gol más rápido en lo que va de Liga: Álex Rubio, a los ¡30 segundos! Pedía Alberto González ver a su equipo mandando en el marcador, algo que aún no había conseguido y dicho y hecho: antes del primer minuto de juego Álex Rubio definió a la perfección un sutil envío de Soberón que, pivotando en el eje del ataque, dejó solo al 19 para batir por bajo a Guilherme en su salida. El Córdoba, sorprendido, quiso el control mientras que los locales, cómodos en el repliegue, salían a la contra con peligro. Fruto de ello se vieron dos goles más que no subieron al marcador: a los nueve minutos y tras una falta botada por Agus Medina, Soberón cabeceó a la red estando, por muy poco, en posición antirreglamentaria, y en el 15 el propio Soberón, también adelantado, asistió a Rubio que anotó. El guión intimidó a un Córdoba que siguió mandando en la posesión pero que ya no se expuso tanto. Las lesiones son la lacra para este Alba y una nueva vino a refrendar la mala fortuna de los manchegos: Lorenzo Aguado se retiró en el minuto 25 por unas molestias musculares y entró Gámez, que lo primero que hizo fue un centro con el exterior para el remate de cabeza de Agus Medina que atajó Guilherme. Seguía el Alba recuperando y saliendo con velocidad y el Córdoba con más balón y menos ideas, un escenario ideal para los de Alberto González. Iván Ania introdujo un triple cambio al descanso para buscar mayor profundidad, con la entrada de Ghailan, Albarrán y Budesca, mientras Alberto dosificaba a Agus Medina. El Albacete rozó el tercero en una falta lanzada por Soberón, que se estrelló en el palo. Fue lo último del Alba. El Córdoba igualó acto seguido con un gol de bella factura de Isma Ruiz que siguió bien la jugada y Budesca asistió desde la derecha para que el 8 marcara con un precioso taconazo. Las lesiones volvieron a castigar al Alba, en el 65 se marchó Javi Moreno pero el Alba ya se diluía y un error de Bernabéu permitió a Percan marcar el 1-2 a placer. El Córdoba pudo ampliar su ventaja con un disparo de Budesca al larguero, cuyo bote quedó sobre la línea y de ahí al final el típico quiero y no puedo de un Alba roto. El Córdoba supo aprovechar la desconexión de un Albacete que se quedó sin respuesta después del empate. Los manchegos pasaron de controlar el encuentro con transiciones peligrosas a encadenar errores y perder presencia ofensiva, mientras los visitantes acariciaron incluso el tercer gol en un remate al larguero. La derrota deja al Alba con un solo punto y en una situación crítica mientras que el Córdoba se reencuentra con la victoria y pone fin a su mala racha.

articles.title: Liverpool watch £51.5m-rated Smit - Saturday's gossip
articles.summary: Netherlands midfielder Kees Smit is watched by Liverpool, Tottenham lead the race for Brazil defender Arthur Dias and Monaco's Folarin Balogun is expected to...
articles.body:
Netherlands midfielder Kees Smit is watched by Liverpool , Tottenham lead the race for Brazil defender Arthur Dias and Monaco 's Folarin Balogun is expected to leave in January.

Liverpool watched £51.5m-rated Netherlands midfielder Kees Smit when AZ Alkmaar faced Sunderland in the Europa League this week - with Chelsea , Tottenham , Nottingham Forest and Aston Villa also among the clubs keeping tabs on the 20-year-old. (Teamtalk)

Manchester United are monitoring the performances of 24-year-old Everton and England defender Jarrad Branthwaite . (Football Insider)

Tottenham are leading the race to sign 19-year-old Brazil defender Arthur Dias from Athletico Paranaense, while Newcastle United , Nottingham Forest and Brentford are also monitoring the defender, who is valued at 30m euros . (Teamtalk)

Monaco have confirmed plans to sell United States striker Folarin Balogun in January after the 25-year-old changed his mind over a move to Everton on deadline day. (Standard)

Several European clubs are monitoring English 20-year-old defender Josh Acheampong 's situation at Chelsea. (AS)

Monaco have admitted that a deal for 22-year-old midfielder Lamine Camara could be possible in January, with Liverpool and Chelsea interested in the Senegal international . (Standard)

Real Madrid will go all out to sign Morocco 's new midfield gem Abdellah Ouazane, 17, who is at Ajax . (Fichajes - in Spanish)

Newcastle United are set to revive their interest in Djurgarden midfielder Bo Hegland after the 22-year-old Norwegian opted against moving in the summer. (Football Insider)

Arsenal , Brighton and Aston Villa are all monitoring Sturm Graz midfielder Luca Weinhandl, 17, with the Austrian valued at £20m. (Teamtalk)

Tottenham are considering signing free agent Mauro Icardi after the Argentine left Galatasaray, but they will not be able to register the 33-year-old until January. (Express)

Manchester City and Liverpool are keen on signing Germany midfielder Felix Nmecha , 25, with Borussia Dortmund expected to ask for 80-90m euros. (Fussball News)

Chelsea have joined a number of European clubs in the race to sign The Gambia youth international Adama Jeng, 15, from Norwegian side Tromso IL. (Football Insider)

articles.title: Kane hits Bundesliga century as Bayern rout Union
articles.summary: Harry Kane scored twice in Bayern Munich's 7-0 demolition of Union Berlin on Friday, becoming the fastest player to reach 100 Bundesliga goals.It's the late...
articles.body:
Harry Kane scored twice in Bayern Munich 's 7-0 demolition of Union Berlin on Friday , becoming the fastest player to reach 100 Bundesliga goals.

Kane scored his 100th and 101st goals in just 98 domestic games, obliterating the previous record set by Cologne's Dieter Mueller in 1977 by 31 games.

It's the latest record that the England captain has torn up during his time in Munich, having already become the fastest Bayern player to reach 75, 100 and 150 goals in all competitions.

Kane's double means he now has scored 156 goals in 156 games for Bayern in domestic and international games combined — an unparalleled statistic.

But France star Michael Olise was the star on the night, scoring a fine hat-trick against the winless Bundesliga strugglers.

Wearing a special kit to celebrate the start of Oktoberfest, it was clear that Bayern were in party mood from the start.

They took the lead in the 18th minute with an explosive opener by Jamal Musiala . Alphonso Davies cut the ball back to Musiala on the edge of the box, and the German let fly with a bullet shot that left Frederik Ronnow with no chance.

Soon after Luis Diaz had a goal chalked off for offside, Kane's moment arrived from the penalty spot. Union defender Tom Rothe brushed a boot against Olise, giving Kane the chance to slam the penalty home for his milestone strike.

Bayern quickly turned two into three before half-time through a fine strike by Olise, who took Musiala's pass first time, stylishly caressing it into the top corner from the edge of the box — but the best from Olise was yet to come.

An early second-half flurry forced Manuel Neuer into two saves in quick succession. The first saw him deny a golden chance for Janik Haberer . Just four goals scored and 17 conceded in their opening four games of the season tells its own story for Union, who are still chasing their first win of the new campaign.

Haberer's miss was as good as it got for the visitors, who went 4-0 down in the 54th minute when Olise was allowed to pick out Kane with a sumptuous cross from the right, inviting Kane to glance in his second of the night.

Bayern coach Vincent Kompany sent on Ismael Saibari just after the hour and within seven minutes he scored his first Bayern goal. Davies, the provider again, found the Morocco star, who shrugged off his marker and thumped in Bayern's fifth.

Olise added his second of the night three minutes later to make it six, beating the offside trap, rounding Ronnow, and sending his shot in off the near post.

Despite Kane's record-breaking exploits, Olise was the main attraction here in Munich. The Frenchman secured his hat-trick another three minutes later bending in a stunning shot from outside the box after Tom Bishof had teed him up.

This ruthless victory is Bayern's biggest margin of victory since their 8-1 win over Wolfsburg in January and, for now, puts the champions top of the table.

Freiburg and Borussia Dortmund , the only teams with 100% records this season, can return to the Bundesliga summit on Saturday when they take on Eintracht Frankfurt and Stuttgart respectively.

articles.title: Barcelona youngster earns comparison with Pedri
articles.summary: Barcelona starlet Xavi Espart has this week earned for himself a comparison with teammate and world champion Pedri. This comes after the versatile defender/m...
articles.body:
Barcelona starlet Xavi Espart has this week earned for himself a comparison with teammate and world champion Pedri . This comes after the versatile defender/midfielder was afforded a first-ever call-up to Spain's U21 setup.

Espart is of course fresh off nothing short of a remarkable start to the new campaign in Catalunya's capital. Cast into a prominent role at left-back by Hansi Flick, the 19-year-old has responded with a string of standout performances.

All told, across five La Liga starts to date, Espart has racked up a goal and two assists.

This ongoing excellence on the part of the youngster was on Friday recognised at international level, with Espart having made the jump from Spain's U19 squad to the U21s.

Speaking to the media after his latest panel of players was officially unveiled, La Rojita boss David Gordo was therefore drawn on Espart's name.

And in his response, the tactician revealed his take that the Barcelona academy graduate boasts many of the same qualities as Blaugrana teammate Pedri:

"His best quality is his excellent understanding of the game, space, and timing. And he can do it from any position. He's decisive as a central midfielder and as a full-back. He's very intelligent. He's always one step ahead. In some ways, he reminds me of Pedri because of his understanding of the game. It seems like time moves differently for him."

articles.title: 'Yeah buddy, I bet he is:' Pete Golding didn't buy it when Lane Kiffin texted him to say Sam Leavitt wouldn't play on Saturday
articles.summary: Leavitt went from "doubtful" to "questionable" on Wednesday.
articles.body:
If Lane Kiffin was trying to pull a fast one on Pete Golding, the Ole Miss coach wasn't buying it.

Golding said Friday on an appearance on "The Pat McAfee Show" that the his former boss and current LSU coach texted him Wednesday ahead of the release of LSU's injury report. That report showed starting quarterback Sam Leavitt as "doubtful" to play.

"I got the text before the report went out from Lane 'Hey our quarterback's out,'" Golding said. "I'm like, yeah buddy, I bet he is. I've been around here a lot of Wednesdays with you man for three-and-a-half years and I said I think our first one we had 42 guys on the on the first-ever SEC injury report on a Wednesday."

The SEC started mandating injury reports for all conference games in 2024. And while Golding is exaggerating about the number of players Kiffin had on Ole Miss' injury report ahead of its game against Kentucky , he's also not kidding that the Rebels had a bunch of players listed.

Ole Miss listed 26 players on that injury report , including fourteen listed as probable.

The morning after LSU initially listed Leavitt as "doubtful," ESPN reported that no one on Ole Miss' coaching staff was buying that the quarterback would be out. And Golding's comments Friday clearly back that up.

Thursday night, LSU upgraded Leavitt to "questionable" after he reportedly participated in the team's walkthrough practice. If you're as confident as Golding is about Leavitt's status, you can plan on seeing him on the field Saturday night.

articles.title: Lane Kiffin calls on frat bros to prepare LSU football team for brutal Ole Miss crowd
articles.summary: Lane Kiffin and LSU are going all out in preperation for Ole Miss return
articles.body:
Lane Kiffin and the LSU Tigers never fail to bring the wildest stories to college football . This weekend, Kiffin is the biggest story in the country, as he returns to the program he coached for six seasons.

Headlining the Week 3 college football slate, No. 7 LSU travels to Oxford, Mississippi, to visit the No. 8 Ole Miss Rebels in a top-10 matchup.

While what happens on the field is most important, there might not be a more anticipated entrance into the building and onto the field than Kiffin's entrance into the Rebels ' home stadium.

This isn't new for Kiffin either; he faced similar circumstances at Ole Miss . Kiffin's Tennessee tenure ended in an ugly fashion. When he returned to Knoxville, fans greeted him by throwing all sorts of items onto the field.

Golf balls, beer cans, and even a mustard bottle were thrown onto the field to close Kiffin's return to Knoxville in a 31-26 win.

Since Kiffin has experience with hostile environments, he's prepping his team for the wildest environment possible. Let's just say Kiffin got creative in how he's prepping his team throughout this week.

Lane Kiffin hires LSU frats to heckle the team at practice

Sep 12, 2026; Baton Rouge, Louisiana, USA; LSU Tigers head coach Lane Kiffin reacts to an intercept by Louisiana Tech Bulldogs during the first half at Tiger Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Stephen Lew-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters)

What better way to prepare for a rowdy crowd of college kids than bringing in rowdy college kids? At an LSU practice this week, LSU students showed up at the practice field and greeted the players and Kiffin as they walked back into the facility.

The LSU frat students met the players with loud boos and signs that trolled the team and certain players. The best sign targeted LSU's premier EDGE, Princewill Umanmielen .

ESPN's Pete Thamel reported Wednesday that Ole Miss served Umanmielen with lawsuit papers. The lawsuit stems from a dispute over a revenue-sharing contract with Ole Miss.

The sign trolling Umanmielen read "See you in court" with a picture of Umanmielen and a judge.

Ultimately, the tactic is creative and probably better than simple crowd-noise practice with boos raining down on loudspeakers. That said, no tactic can prepare LSU and Kiffin for what's coming on Saturday night.

This Ole Miss crowd won't let up against Kiffin, and extra security will be needed. Sports need villain stories, and there's no bigger villain right now than Lane Kiffin.

articles.title: Warren JFK takes control in second half to defeat GV
articles.summary: ORWELL — When Matt Rosati put together the game plan for Grand Valley’s Thursday night matchup against Warren JFK, the coach knew mistakes was something his...
articles.body:
ORWELL — When Matt Rosati put together the game plan for Grand Valley's Thursday night matchup against Warren JFK, the coach knew mistakes was something his football team had to minimize.

For the first half, the Mustangs did a good job. The second half, though, was a different story.

GV fumbled away the second half kickoff, then one possession later, had a botched punt attempt.

Both miscues led directly to touchdowns and helped the Eagles run away with a 42-14 victory at The Reel Family Stadium.

GV (3-2) drew to within 21-14 heading into halftime.

But those two mistakes were something Rosati knew his team could not afford if they hoped to compete for four quarters.

"We had to play mistake free football in order to compete with these guys," the coach said. "I thought we had a pretty good game plan against them. We knew they had a major size advantage, so we tried to spread them out, and I thought we did a pretty good job in the first half, but they just wore us down and that was our biggest fear."

The Mustangs could not have started the game much better.

Carter Turk picked off JFK quarterback Al Howard on the third play of the game.

Then, on the Mustangs first offensive play, Caden Rowland got loose around the right end and raced 51 yards for a score.

But, the Eagles responded by using their size and strength.

Behind an offensive line that had a size advantage against GV, JFK marched 80 yards on 21 plays in more than nine minutes to tie the game on a 12-yard run by Howard.

The Eagles added another touchdown drive in the second quarter.

After the first of two botched punt attempts, Howard hooked up with Lucas Mealy on a 30-yard touchdown pass to make it 21-7.

GV answered with a 50-yard run from Rowland to set up a 6-yard touchdown pass from Turk to cut the deficity to 21-14.

But in the second half, JFK not only took advantage of both Mustangs mistakes, but shut down Rowland. The Eagles allowed him just five rushing yards, after he had 110 in the first half.

Turk completed 9 of 24 passes for 83 yards and was intercepted late in the game.

Offensively for the Eagles, Howard and running back Nick Brianca combined for more than 300 rushing yards.

Rosati said he knows his team has to get more physical, but realizes it's a process.

"We have to take a step back and look at it, but we had eight sophomores and two freshmen on the field," he said. "We just need some more experience and we need to get bigger and stronger and we will. We competed, but it just got away from us."

After a 3-0 start to the season, the Mustangs have now dropped their last two games, including a 33-21 loss to University School Sept. 10.

Rosati said, though, this was the kind of competition he wants his team to measure themselves against.

"This is real football here," the coach said. "Playing University School, playing JFK, this is legitimate football and we see what we have to do. We can compete, can we compete for four quarters against a good football team, that becomes the issue we have to work on. We're playing real football and I'm proud of our kids for that."

GV starts Northeastern Athletic Conference play against Saint John Saturday, Sept. 26 at Lakeside Stadium.

The Heralds are 3-1, with three straight wins, entering Saturday's afternoon game at Lakeside.

"We're excited for the next five games," Rosati said. "We understand what we need to do and we have a grudge with Saint John and we're looking forward to that football game. We just need to regroup, get healthy and get back at it."
authors: Mike Shaffer, Star Beacon, Ashtabula, Ohio

articles.title: Arsenal is in a three-horse race for Spanish star
articles.summary: Arsenal have not forgotten about signing Nico Williams, a player they have been pursuing for some time. The Gunners continue to monitor him closely, but they...
articles.body:
Arsenal have not forgotten about signing Nico Williams , a player they have been pursuing for some time . The Gunners continue to monitor him closely, but they now face greater Premier League competition for his signature.

Since the summer of 2024, Arsenal have maintained a strong interest in adding Williams to their squad, and they have reportedly tried to lure him to the Emirates on several occasions.

However, the winger remains committed to staying at Athletic Club and signed a long-term contract with the club about a year ago. That has made it difficult for Arsenal to convince him to move to London.

Williams can still leave Athletic Club if a club is prepared to meet his release clause and persuade him that the time is right for a change. Arsenal remain willing to explore that possibility as they continue to monitor his situation.

According to Fichajes , Manchester United and Chelsea are now also showing interest in signing Williams. Both clubs reportedly view him as a top player who could strengthen their squads and are prepared to make an approach if they receive encouragement that he is ready to leave Athletic Club.

The increased competition could make Arsenal's pursuit more complicated, particularly after their long-standing interest has yet to result in a transfer. Williams' continued commitment to Athletic Club also remains an important factor.

Arsenal have followed the winger since 2024, but their failure to secure his signature has allowed other Premier League clubs to become involved. United and Chelsea could now look to take advantage of the situation if Williams becomes open to a move.

(Photo by ALBERTO PIZZOLI/AFP via Getty Images)

Williams remains committed to Athletic Club

For now, Williams remains happy at Athletic Club, making it difficult for any of his suitors to convince him to leave the La Liga club. His current commitment means Arsenal, Manchester United and Chelsea may have to wait for a change in his situation before making further progress.

The winger's release clause provides a potential route for a transfer, but meeting it alone may not be enough if Williams remains determined to continue his career at Athletic Club.

Arsenal therefore continue to monitor his position, while the emergence of additional Premier League interest gives the situation another dimension. For the moment, Williams remains focused on Athletic Club and does not appear ready to leave the Spanish side.

articles.title: PLAYER RATINGS | Monaco 2-1 Lens: Filipe Luís side go top of Ligue 1 as Lens’ Yannick Cahuzac era begins with defeat
articles.summary: Ligue 1 McDonald’s, Round 5, 18/09/26AS Monaco continued their unbeaten start to the season and returned to the top of the Ligue 1 table thanks to a slender...
articles.body:
AS Monaco continued their unbeaten start to the season and returned to the top of the Ligue 1 table thanks to a slender win over RC Lens , who begin life under their new manager, Yannick Cahuzac , with a defeat (2-1).

Monaco had to find the back of the net three times to score their first goal. Matthis Abline tucked past Robin Risser but was clearly offside, Edan Diop then did the same, but this time it was Paris Brunner offside in the build-up. It was the offsidemen who combined to open the scoring. Abline beat West Ham United loanee Jean-Clair Todibo down the right before pulling back for a completely unmarked Brunner to net his sixth goal of the season.

It was the same pair at the heart of the next big chance. Brunner was played in by Aleksandr Golovin and drew a save from Risser. Abline was unmarked with the rebound but made poor contact, his shot dribbling harmlessly wide of Risser's goal. Denis Zakaria was the next to sting the palms of the France international. If only Abline could stay onside, it would have been an easy day at the office for Monaco, but alas, he could not, once again straying before finishing past Risser once more.

A switch to a back four at half-time, following the withdrawal of Todibo, allowed Lens to grow into the game, however, and they equalised through Matthieu Udol , who evaded his marker at a corner to head home at the near post from a Florian Thauvin corner. Les Sang et Or were building in confidence as Monaco's shrank. Junior Kadile beat Vanderson and whipped a ball onto the head of Franjo Ivanovic. The Benfica loanee couldn't steer his effort on target, but Thorgan Hazard would test Lukas Hradecky with a curled effort to the near post. The Finnish goalkeeper was up to the task to turn it around the corner.

Despite the introduction of the returning Folarin Balogun and Mathys Detourbet, Monaco could not procure the same openings that were created with relative ease in the first half. Luckily for the Principality club, Lens were feeling charitable. Jonathan Gradit , who replaced Todibo at the break, challenged Brunner for a header. The German couldn't get to it but he destabilised his marker sufficiently to make him turn it into his own net.

Perhaps he could have done better on the equaliser, which sailed over his head, but he made two key saves with the scores level and then was well placed to deny Udol with what was the final touch of the game.

He didn't necessarily look to have a future at Monaco and his selection came as a big shock, but he justified it. Sometimes a little hurried on the ball and lacking composure, it was clear that he was chosen to bring balance. It was his defensive work that would matter here and in that sense he was flawless. He was the first Monégasque to make way, with the more attack-minded Mathys Detourbet taking his place after the scores were levelled.

He scored his two offside chances but failed to score the one that would have counted. Bar his inability to remain onside, it was a strong performance from the former FC Nantes forward, who ran the channels well and won his individual duels.

Replaced by Jonathan Gradit ( 4 ) at half-time. The West Ham loanee was at the scene of the crime for the goal and lost his physicsl duel with Abline. The defender still clearly has work to do to get up to speed.

Certainly not his best night, but his deadball delivery is so valuable. It was his corner that created the equaliser and every time Lens got a corner, you could hear the Stade Louis II hold its breath.

For now, he works best as an impact player off the bench. He was largely outmuscled and lacked the influence that he had coming off the bench in the UEFA Champions League last week.

GFFN | Luke Entwistle – reporting from Monaco

articles.title: Aston Villa Tracking £17m Midfielder Amid Arsenal Interest: Could The Club Benefit From His Profile?
articles.summary: Aston Villa have joined Arsenal and Brighton in tracking a 17-year-old midfielder Luca Weinhandl at Sturm Graz, with a reported £17m fee.The report, cited by...
articles.body:
Aston Villa have joined Arsenal and Brighton in tracking a 17-year-old midfielder Luca Weinhandl at Sturm Graz, with a reported £17m fee.

The report, cited by BBC , claims the three Premier League clubs are monitoring Luca Weinhandl, who has broken into Sturm Graz's setup. The midfielder stands 1.90 metres tall and came through the club's academy before reaching first-team football. Sturm confirmed in 2025 that he had signed a long-term contract after impressing for the club's youth sides and Sturm II. The club praised his qualities.

Weinhandl has made five Austrian Bundesliga appearances this season, playing 373 minutes, with no league goals or assists. UEFA records four Champions League qualifying appearances and one goal, while Opta lists four Europa League appearances with one goal and one assist. He then played the full match in Sturm's 0-0 Europa League draw with Rennes .

Could Aston Villa benefit from Weinhandl's profile?

GRAZ, AUSTRIA – JANUARY 29: Felix Horn Myhre of SK Brann on the ball whilst under pressure from Luca Weinhandl of SK Sturm Graz during the UEFA Europa League 2025/26 League Phase MD8 match between SK Sturm Graz and SK Brann at Sturmstadion Liebenau on January 29, 2026 in Graz, Austria. (Photo by Jurij Kodrun/Getty Images)

For Aston Villa, the attraction becomes clear beyond his attacking numbers. Weinhandl operates as a defensive midfielder who can protect the centre, recover possession and use his height in duels. His record this season shows 31 wins from 60 league duels, while he has completed 11 tackles and made three interceptions.

That profile could suit Unai Emery 's midfield structure when Villa defend in a compact block and ask midfielders to close passing lanes. Against Rennes, the teenager's defensive work showed that value, with two tackles and two interceptions, according to the supplied assessment.

Yet Villa would need patience. His passing remains the concern. The midfielder only has 10 completed passes from 14 under pressure against Rennes, a 71% rate, and his domestic output remains at zero goals and zero assists. The Premier League would test that area more severely, when opponents press Villa high and force quick passes through central zones.

Brighton's interest makes sense given their record of recruiting young players, while Arsenal can offer a different development route. Villa have more immediate competitive demands. Spending £17m on a 17-year-old could become a major commitment for potential rather than an instant solution.

Weinhandl clearly has the physical traits Emery could use. His distribution needs work first. For Aston Villa, this is very important because the club need midfield depth that can contribute immediately.

articles.title: El Chelsea de Xabi Alonso no termina de arrancar
articles.standfirst: El conjunto 'blue' completó un partido muy discreto y con poco peligro generado a la portería de Kelleher
articles.summary: El conjunto 'blue' completó un partido muy discreto y con poco peligro generado a la portería de Kelleher
articles.body: No era fácil el partido para el Chelsea de Xabi Alonso ante un regular Brentford que solo llegaba un punto por debajo de los blues. La primera parte estuvo protagonizada por la ausencia de ocasiones por parte de los dos equipos. Ritmo lento y partido sin mucho que comentar. Ya en la segunda parte llegaría el gol del Brentford, en un centro mal defendido por los blues que culminó Anthony de cabeza a placer. No mucho después marcó Igor Thiago en un rechace tras una gran contra del conjunto local colocó el 2-0. Hubo tiempo justo al final para el tercer y definitivo tanto de Carvalho. Empezó mejor el Brentford con un juego directo que pretendía asustar a la portería del 'Dibu' Martínez. Llegó la primera ocasión peligrosa del Chelsea en las botas de Pedro Neto que acabó con el paradón de Kelleher, aunque los blues no tuvieron el arranque soñado, ni mucho menos. Estuvieron una gran parte de este tramo sin apenas tocar balón y con las 'abejas' apretando arriba. Mejoró algo el conjunto blue con Palmer y Rogers a la cabeza. El primero provocó una falta y el segundo la golpeó... pero a las manos de Kelleher. Aún así, lo más destacado estaba siendo la frustración de Xabi Alonso en la banda, porque goles no se estaban viendo en el Gtech Community Stadium. Por su parte, el Brentford lo intentaba con los golpeos de Yarmolyuk, pero el Dibu aparecía para frenarlos. Así acabó una primera parte sin mucho ritmo. El guion de la segunda parte no sería muy diferente. El Chelsea proponiendo poco, algo de Morgan Rogers y Palmer y no pasaba mucho más. El Brentford trataba de salir a la contra pero tampoco genera excesivo peligro. Algún destallo de Damsgaard y desmarques puntuales de Igor Thiago. En el 61' llegaría el tanto del Brentford. Sería Anthony de cabeza en un centro en el que remató completamente a placer, nada pudo hacer el 'Dibu'. Se le ponía muy cuesta arriba el partido al Chelsea. La reacción de Xabi Alonso pasó por meter a Acheampong y Quenda al terreno de juego en el 70'. Un 11 curioso sin ningún delantero centro que pudiera ser referencia en la punta de ataque. Las 'abejas' no eran capaces de sentenciar a la contra con un Chelsea completamente entregado al ataque. Los 'blues' comenzaron a llegar al área y se acumularon de forma consecutiva los córners para los visitantes, pero seguían sin generar excesivo peligro... hasta que llegó el segundo del Brentford mediante el rechace de Igor Thiago que colocaba el 2-0 en el marcador. Antes del final marcó el tercero el Brentford con el tanto de Carvalho.
